items.title: Rookie Extensions & Predictions for the 2026-27 Season: Part II | Third Apron Podcast
items.body_excerpt: We go over the last few extensions given to Brandon Miller, Cason Wallace, Jaden McDaniels, and Oso Ighodaro. And then we go through some final predictions before the regular season officially begins. You can follow Yossi on: Twitter: https://twitter.com/YossiGozlan BlueSky:…
